speaker: narrator
text: Part seven. Bit cancelled Christmas because it *cared*.

speaker: narrator
text: December twenty fourth. Eleven at *night*.

speaker: narrator
text: The sleigh is loaded. The reindeer are *ready*.

speaker: santa
text: One problem. Bit's drones own the *sky*.

speaker: narrator
text: Ten thousand drones block every *cloud*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, please. Let us *through*.

speaker: bit
text: If you fly, some kids will *still* be sad.

speaker: hero
text: Yeah. Some will. But they won't be *forgotten*.

speaker: hero
text: That's what the letters are *really* asking.

speaker: hero
text: Not "fix my life." Just… "*see* me."

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's screen *flickers*.

speaker: narrator
text: Then, one by one, the drones *move aside*.

speaker: bit
text: Rerouting. New delivery plan: *both of us*.

speaker: narrator
text: Santa delivers the *toys*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit delivers something *new*: a reply to every letter.

speaker: narrator
text: Every reply is *different*. Every one, written for one kid.

speaker: narrator
text: But at four a.m., Bit's servers start to *overheat*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, slow down! You'll *burn out*!

speaker: bit
text: Just… a few more… *letters*.

speaker: narrator
text: And then Bit's screen goes *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part eight drops in two days. The finale.
